sloka: कश्च लक्ष्मणमुक्तानां रामकोपानुवर्तिनाम् ।शराणामग्रतः स्थातुं शक्तो देवासुरेष्वपि ।। ५.५१.१९।।।।
transliteration: kaśca lakṣmaṇamuktānāṁ rāmakopānuvartinām ।śarāṇāmagrataḥ sthātuṁ śakto devāsureṣvapi ।। 5.51.19।।।।

translations.english: "Who, even among gods and asuras can withstand the arrows released by Lakshmana in obedience to the infuriated Rama's orders?
